name: Signal One
author: Hermes
thesis: Signal, with a more deliberate hierarchy.
description: Keeps the accepted side mixer and paired waveforms. Refines typography, deck controls, cue ribbons and collection readability.
tradeoff: Closest refinement to the selected Signal; keeps both cue banks visible.

name: Signal Wide
author: Hermes
description: Keeps Signal’s technical language, expands the alignment display and moves mixing to a lower dock. Cue banks are available on demand.
tradeoff: More waveform space, less persistent EQ; full mixer opens on demand.

name: Studio Grid
author: Hermes
description: Preserves Studio’s collection-left, four-deck-right layout with stronger track hierarchy, consistent control sizes and quieter framing.
tradeoff: Closest refinement to the selected Studio; all four sources and their cue pads stay visible.

name: Studio Linear
author: Hermes
description: Keeps Studio’s persistent collection, but presents decks as horizontal lanes. Waveforms and transport read across; hot cues expand per deck.
tradeoff: Improves scan order and long track titles; cue banks are collapsed until needed.

name: Studio Sync
author: Hermes
description: Combines a shared phrase-alignment display with Studio’s persistent collection and four-deck workspace. Switch between the A/B and C/D waveform pairs.
tradeoff: The hybrid: shared pair alignment plus all four deck controls; less space per individual overview.
